# RStudio RStudio has many useful features which we have not covered. Let us remedy this and cover a few. ## Global options
![](/images/global.png){style="width:200px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px"}
To get to the RStudio Global Options click "Tools" in the RStudio Toolbar, then from the drop down menu click "Global Options.." . You should see something similar to the below:
![](/images/RStudio_global_options.png){style="width:750px; border-radius:5px"}
Have a look through the "General", "Code", and "Appearance" sections. The other sections are more advanced and I would suggest you ignore them currently. Feel free to click on options in the "Appearance" section to see what they do. If you do not like your choices you can click the "Cancel" button to negate your recent choices and close the window. If you want to save your changes you can click the "Apply" button. Change the following for later. 1. Go to Global options. 2. Click on the "Code" section on the left. 3. Click on the "Completion" tab at the top. 4. Ensure "Show code completion:" is set to "Manually (Tab)" 5. Click "Apply" at the bottom followed by "OK". This will be useful for tab completion which we will cover shortly.
![](/images/RStudio_manual_tab.png){style="width:750px; border-radius:5px"}
## Sweep buttons
![](/images/sweep.png){style="width:200px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px"}
Sweep buttons allow you to sweep away items you no longer want in RStudio. There are two main sweep buttons, one for the __Console window__ and one for the __Environment pane__. The sweep button for the __console window__ will clear all the text in the __console pane__. This is useful if you have filled the __console__ with lots of commands and __data frames__. This sweep button will not actually affect any of your work so do not be afraid to use it. The location of the sweep button is shown below.
![](/images/RStudio_console_sweep.png){style="width:600px; border-radius:5px"}
The sweep button for the __Environment pane__ is a bit more dangerous. This sweep button will clear all the objects from your environment. This will remove all the __variables__ you have created. This is not too bad if you have been using the __script editor__ to do your work as you can rerun all your commands to refill your environment. The location of the sweep button is shown below.
![](/images/RStudio_env_sweep.png){style="width:600px; border-radius:5px"}
